nombre_oficial.texto: Cortés Palace: Terraces and Rivera Murals

frase_gancho.texto: Diego Rivera’s murals from nineteen thirty, and on a terrace, a clay granary.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Upstairs are the arcaded galleries where Diego Rivera painted, in nineteen thirty, the history of Morelos from the Conquest to the Revolution. There are also open-air terraces with views of the city and a cuexcomate, the traditional clay granary of the region. This part of the tour calls for more time, because the murals have so much to look at.
